61x 186-3 + 84÷12= 10
questions.solution_en:
We have:

61x 186-3 + 84÷12= 10

After interchanging, we get:

186- 61x3 + 84÷12= 10

186- 183+7= 10

LHS= RHS.

By interchanging the given two numbers (not digits), which of the following equations will be correct?

31 and 8

I. 216 ÷ 6 + 31 - 7 x 8 = 36

II. 8 - 54 + 216 ÷ 6 x 31 + 17 = 282
questions.solution_en:
It is given that,

I. 216 ÷ 6 + 31 - 7 x 8 = 36

II. 8 - 54 + 216 ÷ 6 x 31 + 17 = 282

After interchanging 31 and 8 we get,

216 ÷ 6 + 8 - 7 x 31 = 36 + 8 - 217 = -173

Hence, the equation I will not be correct.

After interchanging 31 and 8 we get,

31- 54 + 216 ÷ 6 x 8 + 17 = 31 - 54 + 288 + 17 = 282

Hence, equation II will be correct.

questions.q_en:
After interchanging the two numbers 3 and 6, what will be the value of the given expression?

12 X 3 ÷ 6 + 8 - 2
questions.solution_en:
12 X 3 ÷ 6 + 8 - 2

After interchanging the two numbers 3 and 6, we get -

12 X 6 ÷ 3 + 8 - 2

= 12 x 2 + 8 - 2

= 24 + 6

= 30

So, '30' will be the value of the given expression.

questions.q_en:
Which two numbers from amongst the given options should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

7 + 15 x 11 - (98 ÷ 9) = 160
questions.solution_en:
Option (a) If 15 and 9 are interchanged, then the equation will be:

7 + 9 x 11 - (98 ÷ 15)

= 7 + 99 - 6.53

= 106 - 6.53

= 99.74

So, option (a) is incorrect.

Option (b) If 9 and 11 are interchanged, then the equation will be:

7 + 15 x 9 - (98 ÷ 11)

= 7 + 135 - 8.9

= 142 - 8.9

= 133.1

So, option (b) is incorrect.

Option (c) If 7 and 15 are interchanged, then the equation will be:

15 + 7 x 11 - (98 ÷ 9)

= 15 + 77 - 10.8

= 92 - 10.8

= 81.2

So, option (c) is incorrect.

Option (d) If 7 and 9 are interchanged, then the equation will be:

9 + 15 x 11 - (98 ÷ 7)

= 9 + 165 - 14

= 174 - 14

160

So, option (d) is correct.

questions.q_en:
Which of the following interchange of signs would make the given equation correct?

17 - 5 x 146 ÷ 2 + 1 = 13
questions.solution_en:
Option (a) If signs ÷ and x are interchanged, then the equation will be:

17 - 5 ÷ 146 x 2 + 1

= 17 - 0.06 + 1

= 18 - 0.06

= 17.94

So, option (a) is incorrect.

Option (b) If signs + and - are interchanged, then the equation will be:

17 + 5 x 146 ÷ 2 - 1

= 17 + 365 - 1

= 382 - 1

= 381

So, option (b) is incorrect.

Option (c) If signs - and x are interchanged, then the equation will be:

17 x 5 - 146 ÷ 2 + 1

= 85 - 73 + 1

= 86 - 73

= 13

So, option (c) is correct.

Option (d) If signs + and x are interchanged, then the equation will be:

17 - 5 + 146 ÷ 2 x 1

= 17 - 5 + 73

= 90 - 5

= 85

So, option (d) is incorrect.

83+3 - 2 X 16 ÷ 13
questions.solution_en:
It is given that;

'-' means 'multiplication'

'÷' means 'addition'

'+' means 'subtraction'

' X ' means 'division'

So, the expression will be: 83 - 3 X 2 ÷ 16 + 13

Thus, 83-3= 80

80 X 2 = 160
